phase_title: Plugin log subject identifier and render classification

findings.summary: Control-scalar removal is Unicode Cc only (LogSubject.NormalizeFileName uses Rune.IsControl), so Cf format scalars (for example U+202E RIGHT-TO-LEFT OVERRIDE, U+200B ZERO WIDTH SPACE) and the Zl/Zp separators U+2028/U+2029 pass into the operator-facing log verbatim. Both security reviews reproduced this (SR-15.4-01 / SR2-15.4-01) and adjudicate it as NOT an ADR-026 clause 2 violation (Cc is the literal 'Control' category) and NOT a secret exposure (bounded to 128 scalars, never a credential; the LogThrottle key is category|event so a hostile file name cannot amplify or evade the volume bound). It is a real log-spoofing / apparent-line-break weakness: a crafted media file name can reorder or forge what an operator reads. The decision is recorded in ADR-026's implementation note and the security-review artifacts, but there is no pinning test (a future silent change to Cf/Zl/Zp handling would not be caught) and no owner/limitations-register entry tracks the optional hardening.
evidence: docs/implementation/15.4/security-review.attempt-2.json finding SR2-15.4-01 (LOW, not_required) and its reproductions
docs/decisions/ADR-026.md 'Control removal is Cc-only ...' implementation-note paragraph

findings.recommended_action: Non-blocking for Gate 15. Give the residual an owner: either promote it to a tracked limitations/accepted-register entry or a named follow-up task, and (optionally) add one LogSubjectTests case pinning the current Cf/Zl/Zp pass-through so the behavior cannot drift silently.

findings.summary: ADR-026 clause 1 states the general rule that a site with an available primary path emits the file-name subject. Clause 3's mixed-site parenthetical groups the 'ineligible' and 'connection unavailable' discards with the sites 'where it does not [have an identity]'. In code, MediaIdentityFactory.TryCreate runs before those two pre-publish discards, so a path is available there, yet the implementation follows clause 3's enumeration and calls the two-argument Discard (item-id fallback). The implementation is internally consistent with the ADR as written and discloses strictly less; the wording discrepancy is recorded in ADR-026's implementation note ('this note records the wording discrepancy rather than rewriting the clause') and adjudicated acceptable by both security reviews. The only effect is a minor Goal G9 usability shortfall on those two discard lines.
evidence: src/ArrTags/Reconciliation/MetadataReconciliationProcessor.cs:117 (identity created), :124 and :136 (ineligible/connection discards use the 2-arg Discard), :340-343 (2-arg overload delegates null), :208-229 (post-identity discards pass PrimaryPath)
findings.recommended_action: No action this phase. A future ADR-026 clarification (or clause-3 edit) should reconcile clause 1 and clause 3 for the pre-publish discards; the phase-15 acceptance criterion is satisfied as written because the mixed discard site uses the file name when a path is threaded and falls back otherwise.

integration_assessment: Cross-task boundaries are consistent. Tasks 15.2 and 15.3 both edit the single ArtworkGenerationCoordinator.LogOutcome record and compose correctly (subject then classification then generic reason). All sites share the one LogSubject helper, so no duplicated subject logic exists; the helper is a pure static function with no state or lifecycle concerns. The worker's DescribeWorkItem centralizes the queue-record format. The classification reads the result's existing properties, so Phase 20's NoFittingBadge will flow automatically without a further change to the log line. No interface, ownership, concurrency, persistence, or configuration inconsistency was found; the subject and classification are not inputs to any fingerprint or persisted state.

summary: Phase 15 is complete and its Gate is met. Independently verified: (1) the bounded log-subject helper (src/ArrTags/Logging/LogSubject.cs) implements ADR-026 clauses 1-2 exactly (Path.GetFileName file-name-only, 128-scalar bound applied after control removal in one surrogate-safe pass, D-format item-id fallback for null/empty/whitespace/control-reduced/separator-only inputs); (2) the helper is threaded through all nine ADR-026 clause 3 sites and the four clause 3 no-change sites are untouched; the mixed MetadataReconciliationProcessor.Discard site uses the file name when a path is given and the item id otherwise; the work worker and lifecycle removal use the explicit item-id fallback and the worker retains its bounded connection/surface context; (3) ArtworkGenerationCoordinator.LogOutcome emits the bounded PassThroughReason/FailureReason/SourceFailureReason when present and nothing when absent, and NoFittingBadge (ADR-024, Phase 20) is deliberately not implemented; (4) no directory, drive, share, full path, credential, or secret is emitted for host-native paths, proven by 190 focused logging tests (167 LogRedactionTests including the reader-threw and scheduled-retry corrections, 23 LogSubjectTests) that I reran green; (5) ADR-020 clause 4 is amended additively (no clause text rewritten), the log path is security-reviewed by two reviews with no open BLOCKER/HIGH, and the attempt-1 LOWs and attempt-2 LOW are genuinely closed in the tree (SR-15.4-01/SR2-15.4-01 -> Cc-only decision recorded; SR-15.4-02/SR2-15.4-02 -> README/architecture host-native qualifier applied; SR2-15.4-05 -> docs/limitations/accepted.md SEC-5 allowlist amended), with the Cc-only and host-native scope recorded consistently across the ADRs, architecture 06/12, README, and the PLANS risk row; (6) the diagnostic state is consistent: tasks 15.1-15.4 done in state.json and PLANS.md, F8 recorded resolved with no stale open entry, phase 15 still PLANNED, no v1.2.0-phase15 tag, and scripts/check-docs.sh plus render-docs-state --check pass; (7) the build is clean and the default suite reproduces exactly 0 failed / 1619 passed / 63 skipped / 1682 total. No task was skipped and every task has worker, reviewer, and test-quality evidence with preserved attempt-1 reports and visible rework entries. Remaining findings are LOW/INFORMATIONAL and non-blocking: the Cf/Zl/Zp log-integrity residual is recorded but unowned/unpinned (PR15-01); the documented ADR-026 clause 1 vs clause 3 discrepancy at the pre-publish discards (PR15-02); the canonical docs cite only the attempt-1 security review, not the independent attempt-2 review or the SR2-15.4-05 closure (PR15-03); the archived F8 evidence cites the attempt-1 BLOCKED worker report (PR15-04); the planning record names an unproduced documentation-maintainer review (PR15-05); the phase aggregate orchestration is the orchestrator's post-gate artifact (PR15-06); and live pinned-host verification of the logging change is owned by task 21.4 (PR15-07). No BLOCKER or HIGH is open; the phase is approved and the next phase may proceed once the orchestrator applies Gate 15 and creates v1.2.0-phase15.
